accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: Salesforce Id of the Account (starts with 001): the record the user is viewing, or the accountId returned by Find Accounts.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Optional extra detail for the follow-up.

dueDate.title: Due Date
dueDate.description: Optional due date of the follow-up.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Optional priority. Allowed values: High, Normal, Low. Defaults to Normal.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Short summary of the follow-up, e.g. Send EU pricing proposal.
